lines.a: 走過生命風浪 駐足在祢的家
lines.b: Through every storm of life, we've learned to stand as one

lines.a: 學會彼此轉向 學會放下
lines.b: Learned to live with love and grace, learned to embrace

lines.a: 一同仰望祢的十架
lines.b: Under the power of the cross

lines.a: 是祢灌溉 是祢建造
lines.b: You called us to You and set us apart

lines.a: 家中一磚一瓦
lines.b: You turned our lives around

lines.a: 這是我歸屬的地方
lines.b: You built a home where we belong

lines.a: 我雖微小 祢卻偉大
lines.b: Not in our own strength, but by Your power

lines.a: 有祢在家就沒有人 還需要懼怕
lines.b: In Your presence, there is no fear, we know that You are here

lines.a: 是祢的愛 讓家偉大
lines.b: In Your love Lord, build this family

lines.a: 祢榮耀發出光芒 唯有祢 是盼望

lines.a: 天父的心湧出 一條生命河流

lines.a: 興起我們照亮這地
lines.b: Lord shine Your light upon this land

lines.a: 是祢牧養 是祢打造 教會一磚一瓦
lines.b: A shepherd to us, building our homes, we are all living stones

lines.a: 有祢同在就像天堂
lines.b: Lord build Your kingdom here on earth

lines.a: 我雖微小 祢卻偉大
